dataset.description: A separate synthetic ledger generated with documented scenario patterns (direct scams, mule chains, splits, consolidation, loops, several victims, account takeover, legitimate look-alikes). No model was trained on it. Account IDs look like FS-1A2B3C4D.

source.freshness_note: Static synthetic snapshot regenerated from a fixed seed when the server is built. 'Data as of' is the latest synthetic transaction time.

exposure.method: For each account that received traced funds, its own balance is followed from the first traced receipt to 72 h later; a traced receipt after that opens a further window of the same length, so every traced receipt is covered and the per-window results are added. Lower bound (lowest intermediate balance): traced funds are assumed to stay in the account until its balance falls below them. Upper bound: no more than was received, and no more than actually left the account. Ranges are per account and must not be added across hops.
limitations: The observed downstream total counts the same money each time it moves; it is not a loss figure.
Balances combine funds from many sources; no method can prove which rupees were the victim's.
Exposure is computed for up to 60 downstream accounts.
